name: Music Kiosk
description: Party jukebox: a Spotify playlist backdrop with a kiosk-owned Up Next queue (search all of Spotify, play next), guest song requests by QR code with configurable rules, and Soundboard clips that pause or play over the music. Invite-only email accounts. Runs in any browser — laptop, iPad, phone. Next.js static export on a Cloudflare Worker; the engine and state live in a Durable Object.
tech: Spotify Web API + Web Playback SDK
